shortDescription: Detect false-positive tests with the J1-J6 judgment framework
longDescription: falsegreen-skill applies six structural judgments (J1-J6) to each test to determine whether it can actually fail when the code breaks. Covers Python (complete C1-C37 falsegreen catalog), TypeScript, and JavaScript. Load AGENTS.md as project context; analysis runs from any prompt mentioning false-positive or test quality.
invocation: analyze this test file for false-positive smells
